documentation.title: Consumer Rebalance Protocol | Apache Kafka
documentation.description: When the first consumer using the new consumer rebalance protocol joins the group, the group is converted from Classic to Consumer, and the classic rebalance protocol is interoperated to work with the new consumer rebalance protocol. This is only possible when the classic group uses an assignor that does not embed custom metadata.
